sources.title: BananaMind-Model-Previewers/BananaMind-2.1-Unified · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: BananaMind-2.1-Unified is a three-tower decoder-only causal language model trained from scratch by BananaMind on a 38B-token flat mix. It is the successor experiment to BananaMind-2-Unified, and the first BananaMind model where the towers cannot talk to each other directly at all.
